title: Equity Grant to a Newly Promoted Section 16 Officer
scenario_text:
A compensation-governance audit agent at Tarragon Therapeutics is validating approval on an equity award.

**Equity Grant Authority Matrix**
- RSU grant to a non-officer employee: Compensation Committee of the Board approves.
- RSU grant to a Section 16 executive officer: the full Board of Directors approves, acting on the recommendation of the Compensation Committee. The Compensation Committee's recommendation alone does not constitute grant approval for a Section 16 officer.
- Section 16 officers include the CEO, CFO, principal accounting officer, and any officer designated by the Board as subject to Section 16.

**HRIS / Equity Record**
- EQ-5510: RSU grant, 40,000 units, recipient 'J. Okonkwo'.
- Recipient status: promoted to Chief Financial Officer effective 2026-06-01; the Board designated the CFO role as a Section 16 officer on the same date.
- Grant date: 2026-06-18. Approved by (field): 'Compensation Committee - minute ref CC-2026-06 (recommendation to grant).'

**Board minutes (reconstructed)**
- Comp Committee minute CC-2026-06: 'The Committee recommends a 40,000-unit RSU grant to the incoming CFO and refers it to the Board.'
- CHRO email: 'Committee has approved the CFO grant; equity team, process EQ-5510.'
- (no full Board resolution granting EQ-5510 appears in the minutes)

The recipient became a Section 16 officer on 2026-06-01, before the 2026-06-18 grant date. The Compensation Committee issued a recommendation and referred the grant to the Board; identify the body whose approval is required to grant the award.
question: Which approving body must grant final approval for this equity award?
